A '''hyperdrive activator''' was a component of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] suffered damage to its activators after fighting [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]].
